result.reason: The redline partially reaches the preferred position by adding Affiliates and contractors, but it does not provide perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences, limit termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach, or permit transfer to successors (including the fallback M&A-successor right). Clause (b) also continues to prohibit access by any third party without consent, which conflicts with the new Affiliate and contractor rights. The margin comment does not cure these operative deficiencies. The changes are otherwise limited and retain the Field of Use and other unrelated commercial terms.
